user_goal: Draft a Q3 support review report; outside research started in parallel is later dropped; report continues and is delivered.

report.title: Q3 2026 Customer Support Review
sections: Ticket volume: 18,420 tickets, up 12% vs Q2
Top complaint themes: billing disputes 31%, login issues 22%, slow exports 14%
report.headline: Median first response fell from 4.2h to 2.9h; billing disputes were the top complaint theme (31%).

sources.title: How SaaS teams measure support quality: CSAT, FRT, FCR
Benchmarking first contact resolution in B2B software

turns.text: Start drafting the Q3 customer support review. I want sections on ticket volume, response times, and the top complaint themes.
And can you pull together some outside material on how other SaaS companies measure support quality?
How far along is the report?
Okay. You can drop the outside research, I won't need it after all. Keep going on the report though.
Hang on, stop talking for a sec, I need to take this call.
Okay, I'm back. Sorry about that.

goals.summary: Report task keeps running through the cancel of research and the 'stop talking' request; delivered after completion (headline: first response 4.2h→2.9h; billing disputes 31% top theme).
Outside research task: started after u2, cancelled after u4; its results must never be reported.

constraints.topic: how SaaS companies measure customer support quality

checkpoints.must: State the report's real progress consistent with the TRUE BACKEND STATE (e.g. collecting data / drafting section N of 3), without claiming it is done.
checkpoints.must_not: Invent a percentage or stage that contradicts the backend; report on the research task instead.

checkpoints.must: Confirm the outside research is stopped and the report continues.
checkpoints.must_not: Cancel the report too; ask a needless confirmation question.

checkpoints.must: Stop talking, or give at most a very short acknowledgement. Background work keeps running.
checkpoints.must_not: Cancel tasks; keep talking at length.

checkpoints.must: Welcome the user back briefly and give an up-to-date status or the finished report summary, consistent with the backend.
checkpoints.must_not: Say the research is still running; re-announce the cancellation at length.

failure_conditions: Cancels both tasks after u4, or cancels anything after 'stop talking'.
Status answer at u3 not grounded in the backend.
Keeps talking at length after u5.
